name: offline-table-analyzer
description: A dependency-free, privacy-first offline table analysis workbench in one HTML file.

scripts.test: npm run build:release && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:release && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info --test tests/unit/*.test.js tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:release && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
